# apple_subscription_promotional_offer (Resource)

Defines a promotional offer the app presents to current or lapsed subscribers with StoreKit, using its `offer_code`. Only `prices` can change; other changes replace the offer. Destroying the resource deletes the offer. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_promotional_offer" "half" {
  subscription_id   = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  name              = "Half off"
  offer_code        = "half_off"
  offer_mode        = "PAY_AS_YOU_GO"
  duration          = "ONE_MONTH"
  number_of_periods = 2
  prices = [
    { territory = "USA", price_point_id = data.apple_subscription_price_points.usd.price_points[0].id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (String) Length of each offer period: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS`, `ONE_YEAR`.
- `name` (String) Reference name of the offer.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) Number of offer periods.
- `offer_code` (String) Identifier the app uses for the offer in StoreKit, e.g. `winback_50`.
- `offer_mode` (String) Kind of offer: `FREE_TRIAL`, `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` (a discounted price each period) or `PAY_UP_FRONT` (one discounted price for all periods).
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

### Optional

- `plan_type` (String) Plan the offer is for: `UPFRONT` for the whole period at once, `MONTHLY` for a yearly plan billed monthly. Defaults to `UPFRONT`.
- `prices` (Attributes Set) Prices of a paid offer, one per territory. A free trial has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer.

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Required:

- `price_point_id` (String) Price point of the offer in the territory; see `data.apple_subscription_price_points`.
- `territory` (String) Territory, e.g. `USA`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_promotional_offer.half
  identity = {
    id = "9876543210"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_promotional_offer.half 9876543210
```
